events.text: Customer C09988 message: 'I never made this $59.67 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3534820.

events.msg: Core toolkit: flagged transaction, card window, card baseline, recurring charges, resolved account history, device neighbours, region activity and prior cases

hypotheses: The transaction is unauthorized Card-Not-Present (CNP) fraud by an external actor who obtained the card details.
The transaction is a legitimate recurring charge or subscription that the customer forgot or did not recognize.
The card has been compromised and is experiencing other undetected fraudulent transactions or card-testing activity.

calls.why: To examine the full transaction history of this card around the flagged event to check for other suspicious activity or pattern changes.
To check if there are prior transactions of a similar amount on this card, which would support the hypothesis of a forgotten recurring subscription.

events.msg: Four specialist analysts reviewing their evidence in parallel

events.assessment: The customer C09988 has explicitly disputed transaction 3534820 as unauthorized. This transaction was conducted via a 'New' generic Windows desktop device, which deviates from the Samsung mobile device used in the prior transaction 3474173. The transaction model score of 0.557252 for the disputed transaction is significantly elevated compared to the baseline, supporting the likelihood of fraud.
key_points: Customer C09988 reported transaction 3534820 ($59.67) on card C09988-K1 as unauthorized.
The disputed transaction 3534820 was performed on a 'New' generic Windows desktop device, whereas the previous transaction 3474173 was completed on a Samsung mobile device.
The transaction model score (model_p) increased from 0.028226 for transaction 3474173 to 0.557252 for the disputed transaction 3534820.

events.assessment: Customer C09988 reported an unauthorized transaction of $59.67 (ID 3534820) on card C09988-K1. The transaction was executed using a generic Windows Edge 16.0 browser profile flagged as a New device, with no prior history on this card. Given the customer's explicit dispute and the lack of established history, this is confirmed card-not-present fraud.

events.assessment: Customer C09988 has reported an unauthorized transaction of $59.67 on transaction 3534820. This report strongly aligns with multiple historical precedents of confirmed card-not-present fraud involving unrecognized devices, suggesting the card has been compromised.
key_points: Customer C09988 explicitly disputed transaction 3534820, stating they did not make the purchase.
Historical cases such as CC-2675, CC-2732, CC-2540, CC-3580, CC-5217, and CC-1777 demonstrate a recurring pattern of confirmed fraud classified as card_not_present_new_device.
Many of these past cases (e.g., CC-2675, CC-2765, CC-2732) involved unauthorized online purchases executed via a 'Windows on edge 16.0' browser signature.
